references.aashto_2011: AASHTO, A Policy on Geometric Design of Highways and Streets, 6th edition (2011), Table 2-1a (design vehicle dimensions, SI) and Table 2-2a (minimum turning radii of design vehicles, SI), read as reproduced in N. Gerges, Practical Geometric Design of Roadways, CED course C08-024, Tables 1.4 and 1.6, and its section on minimum turning paths, which states that the speed for the minimum turning radius is assumed to be less than 15 km/h [10 mph]
references.aashto_passenger_class: AASHTO passenger car design class, which includes passenger cars of all sizes, sport/utility vehicles, minivans, vans and pick-up trucks, read as stated in Louisiana DOTD Roadway Design Procedures and Details, Chapter 3 Design Controls, section 3.1
references.fhwa_hrt_04_103: FHWA-HRT-04-103, Characteristics of Emerging Road and Trail Users and Their Safety (2004), measured standard bicycle: Table 7 (eye height), Table 8 (length), Table 9 (width), Table 10 (acceleration), Table 12 (speed), Table 16 (deceleration)
references.tcqsm_2013: TCRP Report 165, Transit Capacity and Quality of Service Manual, 3rd edition (2013), Chapter 6 Bus Transit Capacity, section Deceleration and Acceleration Delay, page 6-3
references.thh_2000: M. Treiber, A. Hennecke and D. Helbing, Congested traffic states in empirical observations and microscopic simulations, Physical Review E 62, 1805-1824 (2000), Table I (arXiv cond-mat/0002177)
